title: Colour usage
slide_intent: Teach designers to control the intensity of a message through the number and balance of colors. The topic and audience can call for different levels of emphasis.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can retain attention-getting pink and blue for a strong public message and support a quieter sensitive communication with green or black.
demonstration: Five narrow examples move from one-color to multicolor compositions and a case with illustration. Palette chips beneath each image identify the colors used.
practical_value: Choose how many hues the subject needs, then check the actual color areas against the five annotated examples.

content_islands.name: Use principles
content_islands.spec: Set the descriptions of attention and grounding colors beside the chapter rail.

content_islands.name: Progressive examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange five equally spaced columns across the main field. Give each a finished communication, the matching color chips, and an explanation of the palette choice.

content_islands.name: Illustration case
content_islands.spec: Place the illustrated example at the far right to show how additional hues work in a composition that already carries a message.
